decision.summary: Do not place the router order until its radio, telecom, and product-scope facts are confirmed against admitted official evidence.
blockers: The exact wireless frequency bands and transmit power are not confirmed.
BIS CRS and TEC MTCTE scope remain Pending until the exact model and statutory entries are matched.

orderedNextActions.label: Confirm the radio specifications
orderedNextActions.action: Obtain the model datasheet showing every frequency band and transmit-power value.
orderedNextActions.why: WPC applicability cannot be determined from the product name alone.

orderedNextActions.label: Confirm BIS and TEC scope
orderedNextActions.action: Match the exact model and confirmed functions to the admitted statutory entries.
orderedNextActions.why: An unsupported schedule match cannot become a requirement.

orderedNextActions.label: Use the confirmed commercial-import path
orderedNextActions.action: Keep the confirmed commercial purpose attached to this case.
orderedNextActions.why: The case-scoped purpose answer has already been confirmed.

documents.label: Commercial invoice
documents.action: Prepare the supplier commercial invoice for the shipment record.
documents.why: The import declaration requires shipment documents.

policyReview.label: Review the DGFT import-policy entry
policyReview.action: Review the exact ITC (HS) import-policy locator after classification is confirmed.
policyReview.why: The applicable import policy depends on the supported classification.

policyLocators.exactLocator: Schedule I, Chapter 85, applicable eight-digit entry

onlineForms.label: Prepare for eSANCHIT document submission
onlineForms.action: Have the importer or customs broker upload the required documents after authenticated access.
onlineForms.why: The app does not log in or upload documents.

deadline.value: Before filing the Bill of Entry

contacts.label: Wireless Planning & Coordination Wing official contact
contacts.action: Use this contact only for technical support of the portal functionalities.
contacts.why: Current admitted evidence supports this bounded contact value.

value.exactLocator: technical support of the portal funcionalidades

purpose.value: technical support of the portal functionalities
purpose.exactLocator: technical support of the portal funcionalidades

classificationAndRegulation.label: Confirm the ITC (HS) classification
classificationAndRegulation.action: Resolve the eight-digit classification from the principal function and technical facts.
classificationAndRegulation.why: The product name cannot establish classification.

costs.label: Complete the landed-cost inputs
costs.action: Confirm classification, assessable value, freight, insurance, and applicable rates.
costs.why: No border-charge total is released while those inputs remain unresolved.
